title: Extensive Database & Solid Bookings Benefit IQVIA Amid Low Liquidity
author: Na
description: IQVIA reported Q2 2026 adjusted EPS of $3.15, up 12.1% YoY and beating consensus by 4.3%, with revenues of $4.37B up 8.7% and exceeding estimates. R&D Solutions new bookings surged 19% to $3.2B. However, the company faces liquidity concerns with a current ratio of 0.71 and net leverage at 3.6X adjusted EBITDA.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Strong earnings beat (12.1% EPS growth), revenue growth of 8.7%, significant 19% increase in R&D new bookings, and robust free cash flow growth of 23.3% demonstrate solid operational performance and market expansion.
Q1 FY2027 adjusted EPS grew 9.8% YoY, beating consensus estimates, with revenue growth of 5.9% also exceeding expectations, indicating consistent operational strength.
Q2 2026 adjusted EPS missed consensus estimates by 2.6%, with adjusted earnings declining 26% YoY and GAAP revenues decreasing 4% YoY, signaling significant profitability contraction.

title: Accenture's Q4 Earnings Beat Estimates, Revenues Increase 6% Y/Y
author: Na
description: Accenture delivered impressive Q4 fiscal 2026 earnings of $3.29 per share (up 8.6% YoY) and revenues of $18.7B (up 6.2% YoY), both beating consensus estimates. The company projects FY27 local-currency revenue growth of 3-6% with EPS of $14.39-$14.81. Managed Services bookings led at $12.77B, and the company expanded operating margins to 15.3%. FactSet Research and Paychex also reported strong quarterly results.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Beat earnings and revenue consensus estimates, demonstrated broad-based growth across work types and geographies, expanded operating margins, strong bookings of $22.17B with 1.2 book-to-bill ratio, and raised dividend by 5%. However, FY27 guidance midpoint slightly below consensus and free cash flow declined YoY.
Reported adjusted earnings of $4.52 per share, beating consensus by 4.6% with 11.6% YoY growth. Revenues of $634.7M topped consensus and grew 6.3% YoY.
Posted adjusted earnings of $1.34 per share, up 9.8% YoY and beating consensus estimate. Total revenues rose 5.9% to $1.63B, exceeding consensus mark.

title: FactSet's Q4 Earnings Beat Estimates, Revenues Increase 6.3% Y/Y
author: Na
description: FactSet Research Systems (FDS) delivered Q4 FY2026 results beating expectations with adjusted EPS of $4.52 (up 11.6% YoY) and revenues of $634.7M (up 6.3% YoY). Organic ASV grew 7% to $2.57B with retention above 95%. The company guided FY2027 revenues of $2.6-$2.63B and adjusted EPS of $19.25-$19.65, though margins contracted due to higher compensation costs. AI solutions ASV more than doubled YoY, reflecting strong adoption.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Strong Q4 results with EPS and revenue beats, robust organic ASV growth of 7%, annual retention above 95%, and more than doubled AI solutions ASV YoY demonstrate solid commercial momentum. FY2027 guidance is in line with expectations. However, margin compression from higher compensation costs and guidance slightly below consensus EPS temper enthusiasm.
Reported impressive Q1 FY2027 results with adjusted EPS of $1.34 (up 9.8% YoY) beating consensus by a slight margin, and revenues of $1.63B (up 5.9%) also beating consensus expectations.
Posted strong Q2 FY2027 results with adjusted EPS of $1.16 (up 26.1% YoY) significantly beating consensus of $1.08, and revenues of $875.7M (up 9.4%) beating consensus mark by 0.9%.

title: ACN Set to Report Q4 Earnings: Here's What Investors Should Know
author: Na
description: Accenture is expected to report Q4 fiscal 2026 results on October 1 with revenues estimated at $18B (up 5.6% YoY) and EPS projected at $3.19 (up 5.3% YoY). Growth is anticipated across most segments driven by AI demand and consulting capabilities, though Asia Pacific revenues are expected to decline 26.4%. The company has a positive earnings surprise history and an Earnings ESP of +0.31%.

Growth is supported by strong demand for AI and consulting services across most segments and geographies.

Reported impressive Q1 fiscal 2027 results with adjusted EPS of $1.34 (up 9.8% YoY), beating consensus estimate by a slight margin, and revenues of $1.63B (up 5.9% YoY), exceeding consensus expectations.
Reported better-than-expected Q3 fiscal 2026 results with adjusted EPS of $1.04 (up 27% YoY), beating consensus by 3%, and revenues of $2.32B (up 4.2% YoY), exceeding consensus by 0.7%.

title: Paychex Earns 5-Star Rating on Newsweek's America's Greatest Companies 2026 List
author: Na
description: Paychex has been recognized on Newsweek's America's Greatest Companies 2026 list with a 5-out-of-5-star rating, evaluated across financial strength, market performance, innovation, and environmental sustainability. The company is scaling its AI-powered WISE engine, which is helping over 50,000 businesses catch approximately 90% of payroll errors before they occur.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Paychex received a prestigious 5-out-of-5-star rating from Newsweek, demonstrating strong performance across all evaluation pillars. The company is successfully scaling its AI-powered WISE platform with proven results (90% payroll error prevention rate), showing strong innovation and market traction. Multiple recent recognitions and a track record of ethical business practices further support positive sentiment.
